# Ritesh Patil — AI/ML Engineer & Generative AI Developer

> Personal portfolio website of Ritesh Patil, an AI/ML Engineer and Generative AI Developer based in Pune, India.

## About Ritesh Patil

Ritesh Patil is an AI/ML Engineer & Generative AI Developer currently working as an AI Engineer at Abhiyanta India Solutions. He specializes in building production-ready RAG Systems, Agentic AI applications, and Computer Vision solutions deployed on cloud-native infrastructure.

## Core Expertise

- **Generative AI & RAG**: LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, OpenAI, FAISS, Pinecone, Prompt Engineering
- **Computer Vision & ML**: YOLO, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Roboflow, TensorFlow Lite
- **Cloud & Deployment**: AWS (EC2, SageMaker), Docker, Kubernetes, SAP AI Core, SAP BTP, CI/CD
- **Enterprise AI**: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse, M365 Integration

## Notable Projects

1. **Medical Chatbot** — RAG pipeline using LangChain, GPT-4, Pinecone, FAISS, deployed with Docker on AWS EC2
2. **Retina Heart Disease Detection** — Computer Vision system using YOLO, TensorFlow, OpenCV for medical imaging
3. **CEO Agentic Chatbot** — Enterprise automation using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse
4. **Virtual Kiosk** — EdTech offline learning platform built with Angular, Node.js, Express.js
5. **Industrial Object Detection** — Edge deployment system using YOLO, TensorFlow Lite, AWS SageMaker

## Career
